The cited PR text says a callback that returns nothing leaves the old ValueError, which is exactly what is checked.
A registered tool must still run and return its result when an error callback is attached; the result is the tool's own output.
The cited docstring says the live executor calls the functions and returns the response, so both calls must run and return results.
